fixed.explanation: filterCookies prepended '.' to every cookie domain, so host-only cookies matched subdomains. It now requires an exact hostname match for host-only cookies and keeps the suffix match for dot-prefixed domains. Path matching in both places now follows RFC 6265. A path matches if it is equal, or if the cookie path is a prefix that either ends in '/' or is followed by '/' in the request path. So /api no longer matches /apiv2, and a /foo/ cookie no longer matches /foo.

query.intent: Cookie filtering by URL in the browser context cookie store: the domain match, path match, and secure checks used when returning cookies for URLs or when deciding which cookies to send. Domain matching must treat host-only cookies as exact host matches, and path matching must follow RFC 6265 path-match rules (prefix must end at a '/' boundary).
query.symptom: Cookie URL matching is wrong: host-only cookies are returned for subdomains, a /api cookie matches /apiv2, and a /foo/ cookie is sent to /foo.

history.analysis: filterCookies in network.ts treats host-only cookies as domain suffix matches (it prepends '.' to every domain) and uses a plain startsWith for paths, so /api matches /apiv2. pathMatches in cookieStore.ts appends '/' to both value and path, so a /foo/ cookie matches /foo. Both need RFC 6265 compliant matching.
